# 203 — External_Calling

Indicates that an individual external operation attempt is beginning\.

[All events](index.md) · [External category](Category_External.md) · [API reference](xref:Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents.ExternalEvents.Calling%28System.String%2CSystem.String%2CSystem.String%29)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| EventId | 203 |
| Name | External_Calling |
| Category | [External](Category_External.md) |
| Event class | OperationalInformation |
| Log level | Information |
| Status | Stable |
| Introduced | 0.0.11 |

## Usage

Import `Patware.Diagnostics.ApplicationEvents`. This example assumes an existing
`ILogger` named `logger` and caller-supplied variables for the arguments.

```csharp
logger.External.Calling(@externalName, @operationName, @operationId);
```

**Trigger:** Emit immediately before invoking the external operation\.

**Message template:** Calling external dependency \{ExternalName\}\. Operation: \{OperationName\}\. Attempt: \{OperationId\}\.

## Arguments

- `externalName` (`string`): The logical dependency name, without credentials or request\-specific data\.
- `operationName` (`string`): The logical name of the external operation\.
- `operationId` (`string`): The identifier of this individual operation attempt\. Use a different identifier for each retry\.

## Remarks

- Normal method return does not necessarily mean success\.
- Successful empty results can still be successful\.
- Success does not establish application recovery or guarantee future availability\.
- Timeouts do not establish that remote execution stopped\.
- Retries are separate attempts with new identifiers\.
- Cancellation and unclassified outcomes can leave 203 without a catalog outcome\.
- Neither event performs the operation or changes application state\.
